description: This file defines a jQuery UI widget called 'nestedSortable' that extends the sortable functionality to support nested, tree-like sortable lists with expand/collapse features. It includes options for tree structure, nesting levels, and custom classes, and implements methods for drag-and-drop reordering, serialization, and hierarchy conversion.

classes.name: mjs.nestedSortable
classes.description: A jQuery UI widget extending sortable to support nested, tree-structured lists with expand/collapse functionality.

methods.name: _create
methods.description: Initializes the nestedSortable widget, sets up classes for tree nodes, and validates list type.

methods.name: _destroy
methods.description: Cleans up data and restores original sortable state.

methods.name: _mouseDrag
methods.description: Handles the dragging logic, including repositioning, expanding/collapsing nodes, and nesting rules.

methods.name: _mouseStop
methods.description: Finalizes the drag operation, reverts if position is invalid, and triggers events.

methods.name: _intersectsWithSides
methods.description: Determines if the dragged item intersects with the sides of another item, considering tree structure.

methods.name: _contactContainers
methods.description: Handles interactions with container elements, respecting root protection.

methods.name: _clear
methods.description: Resets the state after dragging, triggers relocate event if position changed.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the nested list into a query string format.

methods.name: toHierarchy
methods.description: Converts the list into a hierarchical JSON structure.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the list into an array of items with metadata like parent, depth, and position.

methods.name: _clearEmpty
methods.description: Removes empty nested lists and updates classes for tree nodes.

methods.name: _getLevel
methods.description: Calculates the nesting level of an item.

methods.name: _getChildLevels
methods.description: Recursively determines the maximum depth of child nodes.

methods.name: _isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if nesting/movement is allowed based on max levels and custom rules.
